extension.summary: Browse and download lawful ROM files from Internet Archive
Browse and download lawful ROM files from Internet Archive
extension.description: Browse homebrew and public-domain software, search Internet Archive, inspect available ROM files and download them to a user-selected folder. Users are responsible for ensuring that they have permission to download each file.
